options.name: title
options.description: Heading text. Default: localized "There is a problem".

options.name: focusOnShow
options.description: Move focus to the summary when show() displays items. show(items, { focus }) overrides it per call.

properties.name: host
properties.description: Consumer host; becomes the summary region.

methods.name: show
methods.signature: show(items: readonly ErrorSummaryItem[], options?: { focus?: boolean }): void
methods.description: Replace the items and show the summary (an empty list hides it). Focuses and scrolls to the summary unless focus is false or focusOnShow is false. Throws on an empty message before changing anything.

methods.name: clear
methods.description: Remove all items and hide the summary without moving focus.

methods.name: update
methods.description: Merge options and re-render the heading and description. Invalid options leave the previous options in place.

methods.name: destroy
methods.description: Remove rendering, attributes, class, and the configuration subscription; unhide the host.

events.name: aui-navigate
events.description: A summary link was activated and focus moved to its target.

cssClasses.name: aui-error-summary__link
cssClasses.description: Link to a field; items without a target are plain list text.
